title: wolfHSM backend: bare void* context pointer, no type safety
description: wp11_backend.h stores the wolfHSM context as void* (comment: 'whClientContext* -- cast in implementation'). If this pointer is corrupted or a wrong pointer is stored, the cast to whClientContext* in the implementation will silently proceed with garbage. No magic number, type tag, or handle-table lookup guards the cast. Any memory corruption touching the backend struct leads to arbitrary reads/writes.
